requirements.title: The binding sweep
requirements.rationale: A binding whose workspace vanished by another path would make a recreated slug reachable, and bindings of purged tokens are dead weight.

criteria.condition: StartBindingSweep(ctx, db) is called
criteria.action: run one pass at once and then one pass per interval (one hour by default, held in a package variable tests may shorten) until ctx is cancelled, then return
criteria.contract: the function returns within one interval after ctx is cancelled

a database with an orphan binding
check.pseudocode: go Start(ctx,db); eventually(count==0, <interval); add orphan; eventually(count==0); cancel(); assert returned within interval

criteria.condition: a sweep pass runs

criteria.contract: after the pass no binding names a missing workspace or a missing pats row, and the tokens of the removed orphan-workspace bindings have revoked_at set

setup: bindings: (a) workspace gone and token live, (b) workspace gone and token already revoked, (c) workspace present but pats row gone, (d) workspace present and token live
check.pseudocode: sweepOnce(db); assert bindings==[d]; assert revoked_at(a)!=NULL; assert revoked_at(d)==NULL

criteria.condition: a sweep pass finds bindings of revoked or expired tokens whose workspace still exists

criteria.contract: 34-REQ-4.5 continues to list them

setup: workspace s with a binding to a revoked token and one to an expired token

criteria.condition: a sweep pass fails

setup: interval shortened, a captured logger

setup: a captured logger

requirements.title: Reporting binding refusals as hub.token.bound_refused
requirements.rationale: Refused attempts by a bound token are a signal of misuse or leakage, but a flood must not swamp the audit log.

criteria.action: provide one function to register a process-wide refusal observer and one to report a refusal, both safe for concurrent use, with reporting a no-op when no observer is registered, and without importing internal/audit
criteria.contract: reporting with no observer registered returns without effect

setup: no observer registered
the wsaccess package source imports
check.pseudocode: wsaccess.ReportBoundRefusal(r); SetObserver(f); parallel(100, report); assert f.calls==100; assert 'internal/audit' not in imports(wsaccess)

criteria.action: carry in each report the token id, the token's user id when the refusal point has authenticated the token, the bound slug, the requested slug when the request named one, the method, the route template (the git route for git), the status (403 or 404) and the surface (api or git)
criteria.contract: the api report has token id, user id, bound slug S, requested slug X, method GET, the route template, status 403 or 404, surface api; the git report has surface git and the git route, and requested slug when named; the requested slug is empty when the request named none

criteria.condition: a request is refused because of a binding at any refusal point of spec 33 (binding guard, apikit route guard, wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace, lookupWorkspaceForAuth, the git server, session and audit refusals) or at 34-REQ-1.3 or 34-REQ-4.2
criteria.action: call the report function exactly once for that request, and never call it for list filtering that is not a refusal

refusal points: binding guard, apikit route guard, AuthorizeWorkspace, lookupWorkspaceForAuth, git server, session and audit refusals, mint 403 token_bound, list 403 token_bound
a bound token also listing workspaces (list filtering, not a refusal)
check.pseudocode: for p in points: before=n; send(p); assert n==before+1; before=n; send(filteredList); assert n==before

criteria.condition: the reporter registered by cmd/af-hub/main.go receives a report whose token has no event emitted in the last minute
criteria.action: emit one event with event_type hub.token.bound_refused, resource_type token, resource_id the token_id, action refuse, workspace the bound slug, actor type pat, actor id the user id (empty when not supplied), and metadata {token_id, bound_workspace, requested_workspace (only when present), method, route, status, surface, suppressed}

criteria.condition: a report arrives less than one minute after the last event emitted for the same token
criteria.action: emit nothing and increment that token's held-back count, which becomes the suppressed value of the token's next emitted event and is reset after it
criteria.contract: suppressed is 0 when nothing was held back

one event already emitted for token T at t0

criteria.action: for any sequence of timestamped reports, emit events for one token at least one minute apart, with each event's suppressed equal to the number of that token's reports since its previous emitted event
criteria.contract: consecutive events of one token are at least 60 seconds apart; each event's suppressed equals the number of that token's reports since its previous emitted event; the first report of each token is emitted

a generator of non-decreasing timestamps and token ids

criteria.action: drop per-token limiter entries older than the one-minute window so memory stays bounded by the tokens refused within the last minute, and accept an injected clock for tests
criteria.contract: the limiter's entry count falls to the tokens refused within the last minute; the injected clock, not wall time, drove the decisions

setup: the reporter with an injected clock
1000 distinct tokens reported at t0
check.pseudocode: for i in range(1000): rep(tok(i)); clock.add(61s); rep(tok(0)); assert rep.entryCount()==1

criteria.action: never place the token string or the Authorization header in an event or a log line

reports for a token whose full string and Authorization header value are distinctive

execution_paths.title: An owner mints a bound token from the CLI

steps.action: runs afc tokens create --workspace S --name svc --permissions workspaces:read with an API key
sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/S/tokens with {name, permissions, expires: 90}
passes the credential, binding, admin, ownership and active checks
serves POST /api/v1/user/tokens in-process through server.Echo() with the caller's body and Authorization header
creates the pats row and answers 201 with token_id and token
inserts the token_workspace_bindings row for S
emits hub.token.bind and answers 201 with Cache-Control: no-store
prints the JSON document on stdout and one warning line on stderr

emits hub.workspace.delete with metadata revoked_tokens

answers 401
